one_line: This video provides a three-step guide using facial anatomy and features to determine if a moustache suits a man's face.

hook.what_happens: Transitions of famous Indian actors with and without moustaches under the title 'Moustache Look?'.
hook.why_it_works: Leverages celebrity appeal and a common style dilemma to immediately engage the audience.

Menu card highlighting the second point: Facial Features.
Analysis of facial features (jaw, brows) using Ranveer Singh's face.
Menu card highlighting the third point: Density.
Analysis of moustache density using Varun Dhawan's face.
Outro shot of Vijay Deverakonda with a call to action.

onscreen_text.text: RAVI KISHAN, MEMBER OF THE LOK SABHA

transcript.text: How do you know if a moustache looks good on you?
This clean and thick moustache look is everywhere right now.
So here are three ways to check if it'll look great on you.
One way to find out is to look at the space between your nose and the upper lip.
A long or a short philtrum heavily impacts how your face looks.
So if you have a visibly long philtrum, a thick moustache can break up that empty space and make your face look more balanced.
Research shows that your jaw, eyebrow thickness, and facial height contributes to perceived masculinity.
So if you already have strong brows and a defined jaw, but a relatively plain face, a moustache can become a strong focal point.
This whole look falls flat if your moustache is very sparse.
The moustache only produces the right perception if it can grow thick and create a clear horizontal block.

narrative_arc: Introduce the trend and pose the core question.
Explain the role of philtrum length with visual proof.
Explain the role of facial features and masculinity perception.
Explain the necessity of hair density for the look to work.
Conclude with a call to action.
